faqs.q: What is the difference between wide format and large format printing?
faqs.a: Both terms describe oversized printing used for banners, vehicle graphics, signage, and displays. Broadstroke applies either term to durable, high-impact materials produced on advanced equipment for indoor and outdoor use.

faqs.q: Do you offer vehicle wrap installation in Wichita?
faqs.a: Yes. Our experienced installation team handles partial graphics, full wraps, and after-hours service for fleets that require minimal downtime.

faqs.q: What substrates can you print on for wide format projects?
faqs.a: We print on vinyl, mesh, corrugated plastic, acrylic, PVC, metal, wood, and other rigid materials up to approximately two inches thick, with direct imaging, mounting, and lamination options.

faqs.q: How long do wide format graphics typically last?
faqs.a: Depending on material, application, and environmental wear, graphics can provide consistent performance for up to five years outdoors.

faqs.q: Can wide format graphics be integrated with other marketing services?
faqs.a: Absolutely. The same concierge team that produces large-format graphics also manages commercial printing and Postalocity automated mailing, enabling coordinated campaigns with single-point accountability.

faqs.q: Do you provide design support for wide format projects?
faqs.a: Yes. Our in-house design team assists with artwork preparation, substrate recommendations, layout, and clear messaging to maximize visibility and results.

faqs.q: What is the next step to get started with a wide format project?
faqs.a: Request a free estimate online or call 316-262-3333. A member of our concierge team will respond promptly to discuss your needs and provide professional guidance.
